selection_metric: validation macro F1; accuracy as secondary
data_used_for_selection: Only the original 60000 MNIST training images and labels
test_set_use_in_optimization: Final evaluation only, after configuration is frozen; never rank candidates using test labels
structure_policy: One manually specified DAG; no automatic structure search, no edge ranking or learning
nb_candidate_families: 4 or 8 equal-width gray bins categorical NB
optional moment-based deskew before the same pixel NB
discretization_candidates: training-only quantiles, with zero separated if needed
must_keep: at most two total parents per feature
no pretrained models or classifier libraries
